title: Pandoc Metadata Configuration
description: Schema for pandoc metadata YAML files

institute.description: Institute/organization shown on title slide in beamer

shorttitle.description: Short title for beamer navigation contexts

shortauthor.description: Short author for beamer navigation/footer contexts

shortinstitute.description: Short institute for beamer navigation contexts

lang.description: Language code, e.g. en-US or de-DE

toc-depth.description: Depth for generated table of contents

footerbadge.description: Optional custom key for custom footer badge implementations

header-left.description: Compatibility key for custom templates (not used by default core preamble)

header-center.description: Compatibility key for custom templates (not used by default core preamble)

header-right.description: Compatibility key for custom templates (not used by default core preamble)

footer-left.description: Compatibility key for custom templates (default core footer left is date)

footer-center.description: Compatibility key for custom templates (default core footer center is shortauthor/author)

footer-right.description: Compatibility key for custom templates (default core footer right is page x of y)

default_meta_file.description: Additional metadata YAML merged by core/filters/additional-metadata.lua
